title: Total RNA Extraction, Quantification and Illumina Library Preparation

This procedure was used for libraries without any enrichment or depletion of total RNA with RIN scores > 7 and a concentration of 100 ng purified RNA. RNA was prepared in 5 μL final volume of Nuclease-free water, to start with the first protocol step. The protocol is optimized for approximately 200 nt RNA inserts. To generate libraries with longer RNA insert sizes or lower RIN number, refer to Neb manufacturer protocol. RNA Fragmentation and Priming Assemble all the reaction on ice using a nuclease-free tubes and in a dedicated clean PCR hood. The Illumina library preparation requires 7 steps using the thermocycler with different incubation times/cycles and temperatures; it is highly recommended to create a dedicated folder in the thermocycler with saved programs as suggested in the protocol in a chronological way. steps.title: Sample Transfer and Preparation
steps.instruction: Transfer filters from the filtration system into 15 mL tubes containing beads (RNeasy kit).

substeps.instruction: Carefully fold filters using two forceps to fit in the tube, ensuring the surface with visible particles faces inward.
Push filters down to the beads; do not exceed 2 filters per tube.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Snap Freezing
steps.instruction: Add G2 DNA/RNA Enhancer and snap freeze the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of G2 per filter. If a thick sediment layer is present, weigh it and add 500 µL of G2 for every 0.25 g of sediment (maximum 1 g total per tube).
Snap freeze by immersing tubes in liquid nitrogen for 15 seconds with the lid slightly open, or alternatively, freeze overnight at -20°C.

steps.title: Chemical Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Add lysis solutions and phenol/chloroform to the PowerBead tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.25 mL of Solution SR1.
Add 0.8 mL of Solution IRS.
Add 3.5 mL of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (pH 6.5).
Vortex until the solution is homogeneous (muddy consistency).
Seal tubes with parafilm and move them outside the microbiological hood to avoid phenol/chloroform diffusion.

steps.title: Mechanical Lysis
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples to disrupt cells.

substeps.instruction: Place the PowerBead tube horizontally on a Vortex Adapter (cat. no. 13000-V1-15).
Vortex at maximum speed for 20 minutes at room temperature (or 15 minutes for samples not snap-frozen/phenol-treated per manufacturer protocol).

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and recover the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2,500 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Using a 1000 µL pipette, transfer the upper aqueous phase (approx. 3 mL) to a clean 15 mL collection tube, avoiding the interphase and phenol layer.
If filters interfere with pipetting, pour contents into a new 15 mL tube and repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate RNA using Solution SR3 and SR4.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of Solution SR3 to the aqueous phase and vortex until homogeneous.
Incubate at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 2,500 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 15 mL collection tube, leaving behind a few microliters and avoiding the pellet.
Add 5 mL of Solution SR4 using a serological pipette.
Vortex for 2 cycles of 10 seconds until the biphasic layer disappears.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 2,500 x g for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Decant the supernatant and quickly spin down the tubes to collect remaining drops.
Remove remaining liquid without disturbing the pellet.
Air-dry the tubes for 5 minutes (do not exceed 10 minutes).

steps.title: Pellet Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet using Solution SR5.

substeps.instruction: Shake Solution SR5 and add 1 mL to the 15 mL collection tube.
Resuspend the pellet by repeated pipetting (P1000).
Incubate at 45°C in a preheated thermoblock, vortexing every 5 minutes until fully resuspended.

steps.title: RNA Capture Column Purification
steps.instruction: Purify RNA using the JetStar Mini Column.

substeps.instruction: Place the JetStar Mini Column in a new 15 mL tube.
Shake SR5 and add 2 mL to the column; ensure the column never dries out.
Once SR5 reaches the top of the resin (1 mm thickness), add the resuspended pellet and allow it to gravity flow through.
When the pellet reaches the top of the resin, add 1 mL of shaken SR5 and allow it to gravity flow through.
Once SR5 reaches the top of the resin, shake SR6 and add 1 mL to the column.
Immediately transfer the column to a new clean 15 mL tube and allow SR6 to flow through until the column is completely dry.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Concentrate the eluted RNA using Solution SR4 and SR7.

substeps.instruction: Transfer eluted RNA to a 2.2 mL collection tube.
Add 1 mL of shaken Solution SR4, close the lid, and invert 10 times to mix.
Incubate at -20°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Decant the supernatant and quickly spin down to collect drops.
Remove remaining supernatant with a P20 or P100 pipette without touching the pellet.
Resuspend the RNA pellet in 40 µL of Solution SR7.

steps.title: RNA Aliquoting and Quantification
steps.instruction: Split the RNA for quantification and downstream use.

substeps.instruction: Split the 40 µL resuspension into three RNase-free 200 µL PCR tubes: Tube 1 (17 µL), Tube 2 (17 µL), and Tube 3 (~6 µL). (If yield is low, resuspend in 20 µL and split: Tube 1 = 17 µL, Tube 2 = ~3 µL).
Place tubes on ice or store at -20°C (short term) or -80°C (long term).
Determine RNA concentration of Tube 3 using Qubit (use 2-4 µL).

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from Tube 1.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Tube 1 (17 µL) on ice.
Add 2 µL of 10X DNase Buffer and 1 µL of DNase I enzyme (10 units).
Mix by gentle pipetting; do not vortex.
Incubate in a thermocycler at 37°C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: DNase Removal
steps.instruction: Remove the DNase enzyme using resin.

substeps.instruction: Vortex DNase Removal resin until homogeneous.
Add 5 µL of resin to the DNase-treated mixture.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes, gently pipetting every 2 minutes to resuspend resin.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer approximately 15 µL of the supernatant to a new clean 200 µL tube, avoiding the resin.
Verify DNA removal via Qubit (1-2 µL) or qPCR (1-5 µL).

steps.title: RNA Integrity Assessment (Bioanalyzer)
steps.instruction: Assess RNA quality using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.

substeps.instruction: Set up priming station: base plate in C position, syringe clip at top.
Prepare gel-dye mix: add 1 µL of RNA dye concentrate to 65 µL of filtered gel (prepared by centrifuging 550 µL RNA gel matrix at 1500g for 10 min), vortex, and spin at 13,000g for 10 min.

Prime the RNA chip: dispense 9 µL gel-dye mix into the marked well, close station, press plunger to clip, wait 5 seconds, pull back to 1 mL, then dispense 9 µL gel-dye mix into the other marked wells.
Add 9 µL RNA conditioning solution to the CS well.
Add 5 µL RNA marker to all 11 sample wells and the marker well.
Add 1 µL heat-denatured ladder (denatured 2 min at 70°C) to the ladder well.
Add 1 µL of sample to each of the 11 sample wells (heat denature samples 2 min at 70°C first); fill unused wells with 1 µL RNA marker.
Vortex chip horizontally at 2400 rpm for 1 minute (do not exceed).
Run Bioanalyzer within 5 minutes of loading.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis and Library Prep
steps.instruction: Perform cDNA synthesis and initial library reactions.

substeps.instruction: Dilute total RNA to 100 ng in 5 µL final volume in clean 200 µL PCR tubes.
Perform reaction sequence: Mix 5 µL volume 10x by pipetting, spin, and run thermocycler Program #1. Transfer to ice.
Assemble second reaction: Mix 10 µL volume 10x by pipetting, spin, and run thermocycler Program #2. Transfer to ice.
Assemble third reaction: Mix 40 µL volume 10x by pipetting, spin, and run thermocycler Program #3.

steps.title: First Purification (SPRI)
steps.instruction: Purify cDNA using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads until homogeneous.
Add 144 µL (1.8X) of beads to the ~80 µL second strand synthesis reaction.
Vortex, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, and briefly spin.
Place on magnetic rack for ~5 minutes; discard supernatant.
Wash twice: add 200 µL 80% ethanol, incubate 30 seconds, and discard supernatant.
Air-dry beads for up to 5 minutes (must remain dark brown/glossy).
Elute with 53 µL of 0.1X TE Buffer, vortex, spin, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic rack for ~5 minutes and transfer 50 µL of supernatant to a clean 200 µL tube.

steps.title: End Prep and Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform end repair and adaptor ligation.

substeps.instruction: Assemble End Prep reaction with 50 µL of cDNA; mix 10x by pipetting and spin.
Run thermocycler Program #4.
During incubation, perform a 5-fold dilution of NEBNext Adaptor in Adaptor Dilution Buffer; keep on ice.
Assemble ligation reaction on ice; mix 80 µL volume 10x by pipetting and spin.
Run thermocycler Program #5.
Add 3 µL USER Enzyme to the mixture (total volume 96.5 µL).
Mix 80 µL volume 10x by pipetting and spin.
Run thermocycler Program #6.

steps.title: Second Purification (SPRI)
steps.instruction: Purify ligated libraries using beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads and add 87 µL (0.9X) to the ~96.5 µL ligation reaction.
Vortex, incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature, and briefly spin.
Place on magnetic rack for ~5 minutes; discard supernatant.
Wash twice with 200 µL 80% ethanol (30 seconds per wash).
Air-dry beads for up to 5 minutes (must remain dark brown/glossy).
Elute with 17 µL of 0.1X TE Buffer, vortex, spin, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic rack for ~5 minutes and transfer 15 µL of supernatant to a clean 200 µL tube.

steps.title: PCR Enrichment (Indexing)
steps.instruction: Amplify libraries using NEBNext Multiplex Oligos.

substeps.instruction: Assemble PCR reaction using 10 µM Index Primers (Set 1) and Universal PCR Primer.
Run thermocycler Program #7.

steps.title: Final Purification (SPRI)
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup of PCR products.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads and add 45 µL (0.9X) to the ~50 µL PCR reaction.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, vortex, and briefly spin.
Place on magnetic rack for ~5 minutes; discard supernatant.
Wash twice with 200 µL 80% ethanol (30 seconds per wash).
Air-dry beads for up to 5 minutes (must remain dark brown/glossy).
Elute with 23 µL of 0.1X TE Buffer, vortex, spin, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a clean 200 µL tube.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA and assess fragment length.

substeps.instruction: Determine DNA concentration using Qubit (use 1 µL).
Prepare Bioanalyzer DNA chip: set priming station base plate to C and syringe clip to bottom.
Prepare High Sensitivity DNA gel-dye mix: add 15 µL dye concentrate to DNA gel matrix vial, vortex, spin, and centrifuge at 2240 g for 15 min.
Prime DNA chip: dispense 9 µL gel-dye mix into marked wells using the plunger method (1 mL position, press, wait 5s, pull back).
Add 5 µL DNA marker to all 11 sample wells and the marker well.
Add 1 µL High Sensitivity DNA ladder to the ladder well.
Add 1 µL of sample to each of the 11 sample wells; fill unused wells with 1 µL DNA marker.
Vortex chip horizontally at 2400 rpm for 1 minute.
Run Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer within 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final Library Normalization
steps.instruction: Quantify via qPCR and normalize samples.

substeps.instruction: Perform library dilutions (1:1,000 to 1:100,000) using DNA dilution buffer; assay in triplicate.
Perform qPCR using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit for Illumina.
Analyze results using the KAPA spreadsheet.
Normalize all DNA samples to the lowest amount of DNA.
Store samples at -80°C.
